description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeLicenseSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class. It encapsulates filtering parameters for employee license searches, including an employee number property and sorting configuration.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for specifying search filter parameters related to employee licenses, including employee number and sort field options.

properties.name: ALLOWED_SORT_FIELDS
properties.description: A list of fields allowed for sorting the search results, e.g., 'el.licenseIssuedDate'.

properties.name: empNumber
properties.description: The employee number used as a search filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters and sets default sort field to 'el.licenseIssuedDate'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter to the provided integer value.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the default sort field for license issued date.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Getter method for the employee number property.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Setter method that assigns the employee number property.
